prerequisites: Ability to turn or rebuke one or more creature types.
system.benefit: Each time you take this feat, you can turn or rebuke a particular creature type four more times per day than normal.
system.normal: Without this feat, a character can typically turn or rebuke a creature type (usually undead) a number of times per day equal to three plus his Charisma modifier.
system.special: You can gain this feat multiple times. Each time you take the feat, you may apply its effects to one creature type you can turn or rebuke. Its effects stack.
